description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the additional instant or sorcery and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying at most {B}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the additional instant or sorcery.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
